currency: none (volumes in thousands of garment pieces)

grains.RAW.FACTORIES: one row per fictional garment factory (Vietnamese city or province x product category)
grains.RAW.FACTORY_DAILY: one row per factory per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.STYLE_APPROVALS: one row per factory (PP sample approval snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide order shipment FORECAST; WIP gap ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ORDER_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic order-risk follow-up SOPs (one per product category and order-risk signal)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.ORDER_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.ORDER_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, factory, order-risk signal and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (factories, daily buyer-order shipments, confirmed late shipments by factory, late-shipment risk, order-status events loaded) over an existing Snowflake data source
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose stream (Direct PUT) of buyer order-status events -> S3 (orders/) -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_ORDERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ORDER_ALERT logs new FLAG events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.late_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed late shipment in next 7 days) per factory, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
aws.live_orders: Amazon Data Firehose stream -> S3 -> Snowpipe
